crossRefs.note: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who…
Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock…
I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.’
I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit…
So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to…
But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat…
But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and…
they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
When they had preached the Good News to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and…
They passed through Pisidia, and came to Pamphylia.
When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may…
But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your…
because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good…
night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
translations.bsb: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let us go back and visit the brothers in every town where we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
translations.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
translations.asv: And after some days Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us return now and visit the brethren in every city wherein we proclaimed the word of the Lord, and see how they fare.
